overlap: M-self-representing-stack and M-three-column-stack are predecessor/successor on the same arc — the latter resolves three RE-OPENED gaps in the former (persistence, all three columns, cross-column invariants). Both treat the stack as a hypergraph and ground claims in reflection envelopes.

M-stack-geometry and M-stack-stereolithography are sibling — both publish over WebArxana/VSATARCS/VSAT, share the futon1a substrate and MiniLM embedding tooling, and both treat the stack as a semilattice not a tree.

M-the-futon-stack and M-three-column-stack converge on AIF+ invariants (I1–I6) as the structural language: three-column makes them check cross-column consistency; the-futon-stack makes them the cognitive faculties of a homeostatic agent.
All five missions agree the substrate is a hypergraph (futon1a XTDB), that maturity must be evidence-backed, and that the stack is a semilattice not a DAG.
complementarity: M-the-futon-stack provides the most explicit subsystem table — futon7..futon0..futon3a..futon3b..futon3c..futon1a..futon4..futon5 mapped to AIF roles and timescales. This is the cleanest IDENTITY-layer mapping.

M-three-column-stack provides the schema and invariants — entity types per column, relation types, hyperedge types, INV-1..INV-5 with core.logic implementations. This is the cleanest DATA-MODEL layer.
M-self-representing-stack provides the navigation idiom — typed hyperedges, tension hyperedges as frozen dynamics, reflection-grounded scholia, 6-gate trace path. This is the cleanest BROWSING layer.

M-stack-geometry provides the empirical topology — 110 missions clustered, 293 sorries semilatticed, A/B divergence as identification-drift signal, anthology stories. This is the SPATIAL layer that has actually shipped.

M-stack-stereolithography provides the capability-status readout — exists-already/emerging/declared with pressure axis, invariant families as canonical nodes, vertical Mermaid render. This is the CAPABILITY-AUDIT layer.
Read together: identity (the-futon-stack) → schema (three-column) → navigation (self-representing) → topology (geometry) → capability-status (stereolithography). They stack.
tensions: M-the-futon-stack frames the stack as a single homeostatic agent (one organism, AIF+ blanket); M-three-column-stack frames it as three columns (math/project/code) of one wiring diagram; M-stack-geometry frames it as a sorry semilattice across 7 scales. Not contradictory but the choice of CANONICAL NODE differs (subsystem-shape vs entity-type vs sorry-vs-capability).

M-stack-geometry committed to MiniLM embedding + cluster centroids as the topology — discovered force-directed-with-pins is sufficient. M-stack-stereolithography committed to vertical Mermaid TB semilattice with explicit ordering. Different visual idioms.

M-self-representing-stack proposed AIF+ subsystem diagram in futon5; the actual practice has been WebArxana + VSAT + piano-roll Mermaid + Mermaid TB. The futon5 AIF+ canonical diagram has NOT been built as such — it lives only in the table at line 67.

M-stack-geometry's three-surface table (narrative/structural/thematic) and M-stack-stereolithography's exists/emerging/declared bands are partly orthogonal: one is reading-mode, the other is capability-state. A unified diagram would need to carry both axes.
cross_mission_synthesis.most_actionable_proposal: Build the diagram as an Arxana-hypergraph-backed WebArxana view layered with Mermaid renders for printable sub-slices. Specifically: (1) one canonical futon1a substrate (already exists — 1,524+ hyperedges from three-column + 293 sorries + 110 missions + 16 invariant families); (2) the M-the-futon-stack AIF+ subsystem table at the apex (the cleanest 'big diagram' candidate — eight subsystems, AIF roles, timescales — already at futon4/holes/missions/M-self-representing-stack.md:67); (3) navigation projections per Joe's interests via existing WebArxana entity searches; (4) Mermaid TB sub-views (the three views in the-futon-stack and the vertical layered semilattice from stereolithography Checkpoint 2) for printable form. The single most under-leveraged artifact is the AIF+ subsystem table at line 67 of M-self-representing-stack — eight rows assigning each repo a role and timescale, never converted into a single rendered diagram. That table IS the big diagram waiting to be drawn; everything else is overlay.

diagram_form_recommendation_input.if_form_is_Mermaid: M-the-futon-stack already proves Mermaid is sufficient for runtime topology, invariant taxonomy, and homeostatic loop. M-stack-stereolithography Checkpoint 2 proves vertical TB layered semilattices work. Mermaid is the right form for PRINTABLE sub-slices.
diagram_form_recommendation_input.if_form_is_Arxana_hypergraph: M-self-representing-stack + M-three-column-stack + M-stack-geometry have already shipped the substrate. Arxana is the right form for NAVIGABLE / INTERACTIVE / CROSS-CUT views. The data is already there — diagram = configure the viewer, not build new substrate.
diagram_form_recommendation_input.if_form_is_VSAT_anthology: M-stack-geometry already shipped 37 stories / 276 scenes. VSAT is the right form for NARRATIVE / ONBOARDING / EXPOSITORY exploration.
diagram_form_recommendation_input.if_form_is_single_canonical_picture: The AIF+ subsystem table (M-self-representing-stack:67) is the unique candidate that has not yet been drawn. All other diagrams Joe has are at the parts level, not the whole-stack level.
diagram_form_recommendation_input.recommendation: The diagram should be COMPOUND: Arxana-hypergraph for navigation + Mermaid TB renders for printable canonical views + the AIF+ subsystem diagram (futon0..futon7 with AIF roles and timescales) at the apex as the 'big diagram'. Single-canonical-picture form would be a futon5 AIF+ wiring diagram OF THE STACK — which M-self-representing-stack identifies as the missing artifact ('the stack-level diagram would be the first instance where futon5 describes itself as part of the organism it specifies', line 92).
